disclaimer: This is a web version of Tsukihime, a visual novel published on 2000 by Type-Moon.
The game contains adult content and is intended for mature audiences only.

about.port: This is a web version of Kagetsu Tohya, a visual novel published on 2001 by Type-Moon.
about.project: The project is available on %0GitHub%1. Add a star if you like it! Contributions are welcome.
about.feedback: Send your feedback or report a bug %0here%1.
about.data: No data collected, everything is stored in your browser. Manage your data %0here%1.

track-source-help: [b]Original[/b]: Original soundtrack of the complete game from 2001.
[b]Tsuki-Bako[/b]: Remixed soundtrack that came with a Tsukihime + PLUS-DISC + Kagetsu Tohya package in 2003.
config.text-speed-test: Nell'aprire gli occhi, provo una leggera nausea.
adult-blur-help: Apply a blur effect on the images of the adult scenes.
show-locked-content-help: It can be toggled on and off at any time.
smooth-flashes-help: Replace instant background changes with a fade-in transition.
game-font-help: The default font is served with the project.
To select a different font, input its name. It will be loaded from %0 if available, else from your device.
